meanings: the long-lived ('the folk of the long breath'): the wood's name for its own people, as Seren takes it over in Orrowen (IV.6 headnote)
derivation: sell 'long' + hoss 'breath; live' (compound: the head softened, §3.10; h does not soften) + -an (collective, 'the folk of', as mystan, Orrowan, Lodhan); the breath in it is the Mystaeri's own name, Naelear 'those of the breath' [wf12 unit W04]

meanings: a heel ('the back of the foot'); pa sestow visk, both heels (IV.6, the reading)
derivation: a phrase: sestow 'the back; the stern' (O2287) + S misk 'the foot' (O1407) as possessor, the construct with an indefinite possessor (orrowen_v2 §3.2); the dual pa + S of the head names a body's pair, as pa yarl 'two hands' (§3.2) [wf12 unit W04]
